content.rationale: The read interface (S2-read, nqktpzuu) reads node documents from jj, from the change that owns the node; this is the module that realizes it with nothing of the old store behind it — it holds no root and reaches no filesystem. It is handed the runner (M-jj, zruxtxrv) and names the document by a repo-relative path at the owning change id; it crosses the seam (S2-read-seam, zmnqomwt) through M-jj-read (osplmlvq), yields the document whole (S2-read-whole, nkyymtvp), a document that is not there as absence (S2-read-absent, tqvyvkwv) — not empty contents, not a failure — and one that is there but cannot be read as a carried failure (S2-read-fail, wvrnvwzt), never rendered here. Its id → document entry locates the document at nodes/<id>.json through M-store-path (vkztyrzm), the one derivation, and reads it at the owning change. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/store_read.rs.
